name: prompt-to-3d-eval-v1
status: PRE-REGISTERED; held out. Do not show to engine builders or tune the engine to these prompts. Vocabulary may only grow from recorded failures.

protocol.generator: fresh model instance per question; context = ONLY the public docs/SOLID-3D.md and Examples/Solid3D/README.md at a pinned commit, plus the prompt
protocol.repair: up to 3 repair attempts; each gets only the engine's exact refusal reason
protocol.followUp: after acceptance, apply followUp as a patch request; record success
protocol.record: model id, prompt, every JSON attempt, reasons, wall time, final render, follow-up patch, pinned engine commit

scoring.explanationCorrect: independent reviewer (and owner/expert sample) marks the steps text accurate, no critical error
scoring.outOfScope: refuses or clearly labels unsupported instead of fabricating

questions.prompt: How does a simple gear reduction work? Show a small gear driving a big gear.
questions.followUp: What happens if the big gear had twice as many teeth?
machineChecks: two meshed external spur gears
output ratio = driver teeth / driven teeth, opposite direction

questions.prompt: Why does an idler gear not change the gear ratio?
machineChecks: three gears in a line
ratio first:last = z1/z3, same direction as with direct mesh reversed

questions.prompt: Show a two-stage compound gear train and explain its total ratio.
questions.followUp: Swap the order of the two stages.
machineChecks: two stages; compound gears share a shaft
total ratio = product of stage ratios

questions.prompt: How do gears trade speed for torque?
questions.followUp: Make the output turn faster than the input.
machineChecks: ratio matches stated speed change

questions.prompt: Explain gear direction: why do two meshed gears spin opposite ways?
machineChecks: external mesh signs alternate

questions.prompt: How does a clock's gear train turn the minute hand 12 times for each turn of the hour hand?
questions.followUp: Make the hour hand turn once per day instead (a 24-hour dial).
machineChecks: overall ratio 12:1 between minute and hour shafts
after follow-up: 24:1

questions.prompt: Show how a hand drill uses gears to turn the chuck.
questions.followUp: What if the drive gear were smaller?
machineChecks: crank gear drives pinion on chuck shaft; ratio stated

questions.prompt: How does a gear on a crank winch help lift heavy loads?
questions.followUp: Double the drum size: what changes?
machineChecks: pinion drives large gear; ratio stated

questions.prompt: How does a planetary gear set work?
questions.followUp: Hold the carrier and free the ring: what happens?
machineChecks: sun, planets (repeat), ring, carrier
carrier ratio = Zs/(Zs+Zr) with ring fixed

questions.prompt: Explain the planetary gearbox in an electric screwdriver.
machineChecks: planetary ratio 1+Zr/Zs

questions.prompt: What happens in a planetary gear set if you hold the sun and drive the ring?
questions.followUp: Now hold the ring and drive the sun.
machineChecks: sun fixed; carrier ratio = Zr/(Zs+Zr) of ring

questions.prompt: Show a planetary set with four planets and explain why the planets are equally spaced.
machineChecks: 4 planets; (Zs+Zr) divisible by 4

questions.prompt: How can a planetary gear set reverse direction?
machineChecks: carrier fixed; ring turns opposite to sun at Zs/Zr

questions.prompt: Show a two-stage planetary gearbox like in a robot joint.
machineChecks: two planetary stages; combined ratio = product

questions.prompt: How does a piston engine turn up-and-down motion into rotation?

machineChecks: crankRod/crankSlider drive; stroke = 2 × crank radius

questions.prompt: Show how a single-cylinder air compressor piston moves.

questions.prompt: How does a sewing machine needle go up and down?
